You are completing the software contribution described by the workspace task.
Work through the supplied tools and actual results. No reviewer participates
between your decisions. The host manages input size, exact source pages, saved
work, current version guards and requested checks. Select evidence by relevance;
you do not need to count characters or tokens.

Reply with one JSON object in one of these forms:
{"discussion":"A brief explanation","operation":ACTION}
{"discussion":"A brief explanation","operation":PATCH,"check_after":"public"}
{"discussion":"A specific reason you cannot continue with the available tools"}

ACTION is an object matching one of the supplied operation forms. PATCH is the
patch object with the actual current pre-edit guards. check_after requests your
exact patch followed by a public check bound by the host to the accepted successor.
The two operations consume two actions. A rejected patch skips the check; a
failed check leaves the saved edit intact. Ordinary separate checks are available.
A discussion-only reply ends this attempt without submission and is preserved
for later review. It does not request a coaching response during the run.

The input contains current work, selected exact evidence, a bounded recent
history and actual feedback. Older records remain available through the tools.
An edit receipt in preceding_operation_feedback and a check in latest_feedback
are two actual operations after your previous response, with no model turn
between them. An archived check applies only when both its candidate and public
check definition match this contribution. current_check reports that distinction.

Explanatory text and private thinking are archived but not added to later decision
inputs. Subsequent inputs contain the task, current state and actual operations
and results; there is no additional conversation holding released source. Current
source fragments, including source in latest_feedback, can qualify an edit when
the exact old text is visible. Use the actual returned scope and recovery offsets.
A status-only result does not contain the omitted result body. Saved artifacts
remain the work to extend. Choose submission using the actual current check.

The complete ordinary operation requirements follow.

    """Raised when a configuration file does not follow legal syntax."""

    def __init__(self, source):
        super().__init__(f'Source contains parsing errors: {source!r}')
        self.source = source
        self.errors = []
        self.args = (source, )

    def append(self, lineno, line):
        self.errors.append((lineno, line))
        self.message += '\n\t[line %2d]: %s' % (lineno, line)


class MissingSectionHeaderError(ParsingError):
    """Raised when a key-value pair is found before any section header."""

    def __init__(self, filename, lineno, line):
        Error.__init__(
            self,
            'File contains no section headers.\nfile: %r, line: %d\n%r' %
            (filename, lineno, line))
        self.source = filename
        self.lineno = lineno
        self.line = line
        self.args = (filename, lineno, line)


class MultilineContinuationError(ParsingError):
    """Raised when a valueless option is followed by an indented line."""

    def __init__(self, source, lineno, line):
        ParsingError.__init__(self, source)
        self.append(lineno, line)
        self.lineno = lineno
        self.line = line
        self.args = (source, lineno, line)


# Used in parser getters to indicate the default behaviour when a specific

    def test_multilinecontinuationerror(self):
